## Load packages and functions

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
```

# Import metadata file, and taxonomic and functional data
# It is recommended to perform smoothing analysis using integer abundance data

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./data/Metadata.csv", row.names=1, header = T)
head(design)
spe1 <- read.csv("./data/KOs.count.csv", row.names=1, header = T)
spe1 <- read.csv("./data/Species.count.csv", row.names=1, header = T)
spe1[1:5,1:5]
spe <- t(spe1[,rownames(design)]) %>% as.data.frame()
spe <- spe[,colSums(spe)>0]
```



```{r}
# Observed species
S.obs <- function(x = ""){
  rowSums(x > 0) * 1
}

# Identify the minimum sequencing depth
spe.S <- S.obs(spe)
min.N <- min(rowSums(spe))  
spe.int <- round(spe, 0)

# Rarefaction;  It takes time to calculate.
rarefied <- rrarefy(spe.int, sample = min.N) 
rowSums(rarefied)

# Plot rarefaction curve
rarecurve(x = rarefied, step = 100, col = "blue", cex = 0.6, las = 1)
abline(0, 1, col = 'red')             
text(1500, 1500, "1:1", pos = 2, col = 'red')

# Export rarefied abundance table for α-diversity analysis
write.csv(rarefied, file = "./output/Species.count_rarefied.csv")
write.csv(rarefied, file = "./output/KOs.count_rarefied.csv")
```

# Calculate taxonomic α-diversity and perform statistical analysis

```{r}
spe_trans <- read.csv("./output/Species.count_rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

# Shannon diversity
Shannon <- diversity(spe_trans) 
Shannon

# Within-group mean
tapply(Shannon, design$Irrigation, mean)

# Linear mixed effect model to analyze the effect of irrigation, with state included as random factor
anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 11.50, p = 0.0011


# Simpson
Inv_Simpson <- diversity(spe_trans, "inv")
Inv_Simpson
# Within-group mean
tapply(Inv_Simpson, design$Irrigation, mean)
# Linear mixed effect model to analyze the effect of irrigation, with state included as random factor
anova(lmer(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 14.95, p = 0.0001


# Richness
S <- specnumber(spe_trans)
S

# Within-group mean
tapply(S, design$Irrigation, mean)
# Linear mixed effect model to analyze the effect of irrigation, with state included as random factor
anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 0.273, p = 0.6033


# Pielou_evenness
Pielou_evenness <- Shannon/log(S)
Pielou_evenness

# Within-group mean
tapply(Pielou_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean)
# Linear mixed effect model to analyze the effect of irrigation, with state included as random factor
anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 14.05, p = 0.0004


# Simpson_evenness
Simpson_evenness <- Inv_Simpson/S
Simpson_evenness

# Within-group mean
tapply(Simpson_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean)
# Linear mixed effect model to analyze the effect of irrigation, with state included as random factor
anova(lmer(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 19.56,  p = 3.393e-05

# Export the diversity indexes calculated
report = cbind(Shannon, Inv_Simpson, S, Pielou_evenness, Simpson_evenness)
head(report)
write.csv(report, file = "./output/Species_alpha_diversity_Rarefied.csv")
```


# Calculate functional α-diversity and perform statistical analysis

```{r}
spe_trans <- read.csv("./output/KOs.count_rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

# Shannon diversity
Shannon <- diversity(spe_trans)
Shannon
# Export .csv file
#write.csv(as.data.frame(Shannon), file="Shannon_rare_species.csv")

# Within-group mean
tapply(Shannon, design$Irrigation, mean)

# Linear mixed effect model to analyze the effect of irrigation
anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 5.21, p = 0.0254


# Simpson
Inv_Simpson <- diversity(spe_trans, "inv")
Inv_Simpson

tapply(Inv_Simpson, design$Irrigation, mean)
anova(lmer(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 3.76, p = 0.056


# Richness
S <- specnumber(spe_trans)
S

tapply(S, design$Irrigation, mean)
anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 0.002, p = 0.967


# Pielou_evenness
Pielou_evenness <- Shannon/log(S)
Pielou_evenness

tapply(Pielou_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean)
anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 2.72, p = 0.1033


# Simpson_evenness
Simpson_evenness <- Inv_Simpson/S
Simpson_evenness

tapply(Simpson_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean)
anova(lmer(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))  # F = 1.945, p = 0.1674

# Export the diversity indexes calculated
report = cbind(Shannon, Inv_Simpson, S, Pielou_evenness, Simpson_evenness)
head(report)
write.csv(report, file = "./output/KOs_alpha_diveristy_Rarefied.csv")
```


# Plot taxonomic alpha-diversity

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
design <- read.csv("./data/Metadata.csv", header = T)
data1 <- read.csv("./output/Species_alpha_diversity_Rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
data <- cbind(design, data1)

# Set up figure parameters
colors <- c("irrigated"="#4169B2", "non-irrigated"="#BB2BA0")
theme.plot <- theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 17),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(colour= "black", size= 17, angle= 35, hjust = 1),
                    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 17),
                    legend.position = "NULL",
                    panel.border = element_rect(color="black", size=1),
                    panel.grid = element_blank())

# Shannon diversity
range(data$Shannon)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Shannon, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth=0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 1.4, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme.plot + 
  xlab(NULL) + ylab("Shannon diversity") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(3.9, 4.65), breaks =seq(3.9, 4.65, 0.2))
p1
ggsave("./output/Shannon_Taxonomy.pdf", p1, width = 3.5, height = 4)

```
